Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting devices and appending the .PLAY extension to encrypted files

Attack Vector: Potential phishing attack leveraging leaked employee email addresses from Lapsus$ breach of Globant
Indicators of Compromise: ReadMe.txt ransom note at root of hard drive containing 'PLAY' and contact email
